summary: TRACK 24.12 Phase A1 RETEST · Photo Append P0 · PASS. The wiring fix (photos={...} at all 3 <PhotoUpload/> call sites in daily-report-v3/sections.jsx L1091, L1247, L1287) now propagates. Live Playwright on /daily/new confirms append across 3 batches: 3 → 5 → 9. Delete idx=2 → 8. Material ticket-photo uploader → 2. Outbound ticket-photo uploader → 2. Backend static-lock suite 5/5 green (including the new test_sections_pass_photos_prop_not_value wiring lock). Only anomaly: after reload the main photo grid renders 0 thumbs, but useFormDraft.js is documented as a *manual-restore* hook (needs user tap on the restore prompt), so this is by-design and not a regression of the P0.

integration_issues.flow: Draft auto-restore on /daily/new reload (out of P0 scope)
integration_issues.issue: After 2.5s autosave debounce + reload, main photos thumb count = 0. useFormDraft is a manual-restore hook (see file header), so a restore banner/prompt likely needs to be clicked. Recommend verifying the restore banner path in a follow-up if silent auto-restore was intended.

action_items: None for the P0. Optional follow-up: if silent restore-on-reload was intended for photos, wire useFormDraft's restore banner and re-verify the 8-thumb post-reload assertion. Otherwise the retest closes Track 24.12 Phase A1.
critical_code_review_comments: Consider adding a PropTypes/TS check or dev-warning in PhotoUpload for unexpected `value` prop to prevent future silent no-op wirings.

Delete-correctness assertion in Playwright is unreliable with identical synthetic JPEGs (all compressImage outputs converge to the same dataURL). Prefer unique random-noise files for future append tests if you want to prove which index was removed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for P0 append (3→5→9 across 3 batches + delete + material + outbound); reload-restore is manual-restore by design

context_for_next_testing_agent: Track 24.12 A1 P0 is closed. Append (3→5→9), delete-by-index, and both ticket-photo sub-uploaders (mat-ticketphoto-0, out-photo-0) all verified live on /daily/new. Backend 5/5 lock tests green. The only open item is verifying manual restore banner UX for photos across reload — if desired, drive it via the restore prompt selector inside the useFormDraft banner rather than expecting silent restore.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — retest confirms fix. Prior RCA (iteration_545): sections.jsx passed `value={photos}` to <PhotoUpload/> whose API prop is `photos`, making the ref-based append fix dead code. E1 corrected all 3 call sites to `photos={...}`. Current run proves 3→5→9 append across live batches with the ref-mirror path executing correctly.
